name: 5 production challenges in multi-agent systems and how Deep Insight solved them
title: 5 production challenges in multi-agent systems and how Deep Insight solved them
summary: Many teams build a multi-agent AI prototype in days but hit a wall in production. This post defines five production challenges (orchestration, per-agent model selection, reliable operation, secure code execution, and monitoring) and shows how Deep Insight, an open source multi-agent system on AWS, solves each.
